name: context-handoff-connection-race
description: Tier-P F1 repro rig for github/copilot-agent-runtime#22266: forces a SECOND extension connection to join a LIVE session already running the installed context-handoff extension, using the runtime's own bootstrap entrypoint (extension_bootstrap.mjs) with a hand-set COPILOT_EXTENSION_PARENT_PID/SESSION_ID rather than the harness's own supervised launch path. Confirms the manual-join tool-name-clash mechanism (validate_external_tools rejecting a second connection under one session_id) reproduces reliably in a fresh clean-room box, independent of the specific machine/session state that first surfaced it. Report-only repro rig, not a regression gate: it asserts the clash IS observed (proving the mechanism), and flags loudly if it stops reproducing (either fixed upstream, or the container's layout diverged from assumptions).

config.CR_HOLD_SECONDS: the number of seconds the first (real, harness-launched) session is kept alive so the manual second connection has a live target to join; default 25

expected_artifacts: cr-logs/manual-join.log (stderr of the manually-launched second connection)

stages.title: start a real, long-lived session (context-handoff enabled) and capture its session id
resolve the runtime's bootstrap entrypoint + bundled SDK path
manually join the live session with a second connection; assert the clash
